python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("beetsplug/ftintitle.py")
s = p.read_text()
old = "        plugins.feat_tokens(for_artist=for_artist, custom_words=custom_words),\n"
new = "        plugins.feat_tokens(for_artist=False, custom_words=custom_words),\n"
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
uv run --offline --frozen pytest -q test/plugins/test_ftintitle.py -k 'split_on_feat'
uv run --offline --frozen ruff format --check beetsplug/ftintitle.py
